020/**
021 * Handle input from Gamepad controllers connected to the Driver Station.
022 *
023 * <p>This class handles Gamepad input that comes from the Driver Station. Each time a value is
024 * requested the most recent value is returned. There is a single class instance for each controller
025 * and the mapping of ports to hardware buttons depends on the code in the Driver Station.
026 */
027public class Gamepad implements HIDDevice, TelemetryLoggable {
028  private static final double MAX_DEADBAND = Math.nextDown(1.0);
029
030  /** Represents a digital button on a Gamepad. */
031  public enum Button {
032    /** Face Down button. */
033    FACE_DOWN(0, "FaceDownButton"),
034    /** Face Right button. */
035    FACE_RIGHT(1, "FaceRightButton"),
036    /** Face Left button. */
037    FACE_LEFT(2, "FaceLeftButton"),
038    /** Face Up button. */
039    FACE_UP(3, "FaceUpButton"),
040    /** Back button. */
041    BACK(4, "BackButton"),
042    /** Guide button. */
043    GUIDE(5, "GuideButton"),
044    /** Start button. */
045    START(6, "StartButton"),
046    /** Left stick button. */
047    LEFT_STICK(7, "LeftStickButton"),
048    /** Right stick button. */
049    RIGHT_STICK(8, "RightStickButton"),
050    /** Left bumper button. */
051    LEFT_BUMPER(9, "LeftBumperButton"),
052    /** Right bumper button. */
053    RIGHT_BUMPER(10, "RightBumperButton"),
054    /** D-pad up button. */
055    DPAD_UP(11, "DpadUpButton"),
056    /** D-pad down button. */
057    DPAD_DOWN(12, "DpadDownButton"),
058    /** D-pad left button. */
059    DPAD_LEFT(13, "DpadLeftButton"),
060    /** D-pad right button. */
061    DPAD_RIGHT(14, "DpadRightButton"),
062    /** Miscellaneous 1 button. */
063    MISC_1(15, "Misc1Button"),
064    /** Right Paddle 1 button. */
065    RIGHT_PADDLE_1(16, "RightPaddle1Button"),
066    /** Left Paddle 1 button. */
067    LEFT_PADDLE_1(17, "LeftPaddle1Button"),
068    /** Right Paddle 2 button. */
069    RIGHT_PADDLE_2(18, "RightPaddle2Button"),
070    /** Left Paddle 2 button. */
071    LEFT_PADDLE_2(19, "LeftPaddle2Button"),
072    /** Touchpad button. */
073    TOUCHPAD(20, "TouchpadButton"),
074    /** Miscellaneous 2 button. */
075    MISC_2(21, "Misc2Button"),
076    /** Miscellaneous 3 button. */
077    MISC_3(22, "Misc3Button"),
078    /** Miscellaneous 4 button. */
079    MISC_4(23, "Misc4Button"),
080    /** Miscellaneous 5 button. */
081    MISC_5(24, "Misc5Button"),
082    /** Miscellaneous 6 button. */
083    MISC_6(25, "Misc6Button");
084
085    /** Button value. */
086    public final int value;
087
088    private final String m_name;
089
090    Button(int value, String name) {
091      this.value = value;
092      this.m_name = name;
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * Get the human-friendly name of the button, matching the relevant methods.
097     *
098     * <p>Primarily used for automated unit tests.
099     *
100     * @return the human-friendly name of the button.
101     */
102    @Override
103    public String toString() {
104      return m_name;
105    }
106  }
107
108  /** Represents an axis on an Gamepad. */
109  public enum Axis {
110    /** Left X axis. */
111    LEFT_X(0, "LeftX"),
112    /** Left Y axis. */

114    /** Right X axis. */
115    RIGHT_X(2, "RightX"),
116    /** Right Y axis. */
117    RIGHT_Y(3, "RightY"),
118    /** Left trigger. */
119    LEFT_TRIGGER(4, "LeftTriggerAxis"),
120    /** Right trigger. */
121    RIGHT_TRIGGER(5, "RightTriggerAxis");
122
123    /** Axis value. */
124    public final int value;
125
126    private final String m_name;
127
128    Axis(int value, String name) {

136     * <p>Primarily used for automated unit tests.
137     *
138     * @return the human-friendly name of the axis.
139     */
140    @Override
141    public String toString() {
142      return m_name;
143    }
144  }

146  private double m_leftXDeadband = 0.1;
147  private double m_leftYDeadband = 0.1;
148  private double m_rightXDeadband = 0.1;
149  private double m_rightYDeadband = 0.1;
150  private double m_leftTriggerDeadband = 0.01;
151  private double m_rightTriggerDeadband = 0.01;
152
153  private static double clampDeadband(double deadband) {
154    if (Double.isNaN(deadband)) {
155      return 0.0;
156    }
157    return Math.clamp(deadband, 0.0, MAX_DEADBAND);
158  }

257  /**
258   * Get the X axis value of left side of the controller. Right is positive.
259   *
260   * <p>A deadband of 0.1 is applied by default. Use {@link #setLeftXDeadband} to change it.
261   *
262   * @return The axis value.
263   */
264  public double getLeftX() {
265    return MathUtil.applyDeadband(getAxis(Axis.LEFT_X), m_leftXDeadband);
266  }
267
268  /**
269   * Get the Y axis value of left side of the controller. Back is positive.
270   *
271   * <p>A deadband of 0.1 is applied by default. Use {@link #setLeftYDeadband} to change it.
272   *
273   * @return The axis value.
274   */
275  public double getLeftY() {
276    return MathUtil.applyDeadband(getAxis(Axis.LEFT_Y), m_leftYDeadband);
277  }
278

301  /**
302   * Get the left trigger value of the controller. Note that this axis is bound to the range of [0,
303   * 1] as opposed to the usual [-1, 1].
304   *
305   * <p>A deadband of 0.01 is applied by default. Use {@link #setLeftTriggerDeadband} to change it.
306   *
307   * @return The axis value.
308   */
309  public double getLeftTrigger() {
310    return MathUtil.applyDeadband(getAxis(Axis.LEFT_TRIGGER), m_leftTriggerDeadband);
311  }
312
313  /**
314   * Constructs an event instance around the axis value of the left trigger. The returned trigger
315   * will be true when the axis value is greater than {@code threshold}.
316   *
317   * @param threshold the minimum axis value for the returned {@link BooleanEvent} to be true. This
318   *     value should be in the range [0, 1] where 0 is the unpressed state of the axis.
319   * @param loop the event loop instance to attach the event to.
320   * @return an event instance that is true when the left trigger's axis exceeds the provided
321   *     threshold, attached to the given event loop
322   */
323  public BooleanEvent leftTrigger(double threshold, EventLoop loop) {
324    return axisGreaterThan(Axis.LEFT_TRIGGER, threshold, loop);
325  }
326
327  /**
328   * Constructs an event instance around the axis value of the left trigger. The returned trigger
329   * will be true when the axis value is greater than 0.5.
330   *
331   * @param loop the event loop instance to attach the event to.
332   * @return an event instance that is true when the left trigger's axis exceeds the provided
333   *     threshold, attached to the given event loop
334   */
335  public BooleanEvent leftTrigger(EventLoop loop) {
336    return leftTrigger(0.5, loop);
337  }
338
339  /**
340   * Get the right trigger value of the controller. Note that this axis is bound to the range of [0,

343   * <p>A deadband of 0.01 is applied by default. Use {@link #setRightTriggerDeadband} to change it.
344   *
345   * @return The axis value.
346   */
347  public double getRightTrigger() {
348    return MathUtil.applyDeadband(getAxis(Axis.RIGHT_TRIGGER), m_rightTriggerDeadband);

350

365  /**

1553  private double getAxisForTelemetry(Axis axis) {
1554    return DriverStationBackend.getStickAxisIfAvailable(m_hid.getPort(), axis.value).orElse(0.0);
1555  }

1557  @Override
1558  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
1559    table.log("LeftTrigger", getAxisForTelemetry(Axis.LEFT_TRIGGER));
1560    table.log("RightTrigger", getAxisForTelemetry(Axis.RIGHT_TRIGGER));
1561    table.log("LeftX", getAxisForTelemetry(Axis.LEFT_X));
1562    table.log("LeftY", getAxisForTelemetry(Axis.LEFT_Y));
1563    table.log("RightX", getAxisForTelemetry(Axis.RIGHT_X));
1564    table.log("RightY", getAxisForTelemetry(Axis.RIGHT_Y));
1565
1566    long buttons = DriverStationBackend.getStickButtons(m_hid.getPort());
1567    table.log("FaceDown", (buttons & (1L << Button.FACE_DOWN.value)) != 0);
1568    table.log("FaceRight", (buttons & (1L << Button.FACE_RIGHT.value)) != 0);
1569    table.log("FaceLeft", (buttons & (1L << Button.FACE_LEFT.value)) != 0);
1570    table.log("FaceUp", (buttons & (1L << Button.FACE_UP.value)) != 0);
1571    table.log("Back", (buttons & (1L << Button.BACK.value)) != 0);
1572    table.log("Guide", (buttons & (1L << Button.GUIDE.value)) != 0);
1573    table.log("Start", (buttons & (1L << Button.START.value)) != 0);
1574    table.log("LeftStick", (buttons & (1L << Button.LEFT_STICK.value)) != 0);
1575    table.log("RightStick", (buttons & (1L << Button.RIGHT_STICK.value)) != 0);
1576    table.log("LeftBumper", (buttons & (1L << Button.LEFT_BUMPER.value)) != 0);
1577    table.log("RightBumper", (buttons & (1L << Button.RIGHT_BUMPER.value)) != 0);
1578    table.log("DpadUp", (buttons & (1L << Button.DPAD_UP.value)) != 0);
1579    table.log("DpadDown", (buttons & (1L << Button.DPAD_DOWN.value)) != 0);
1580    table.log("DpadLeft", (buttons & (1L << Button.DPAD_LEFT.value)) != 0);
1581    table.log("DpadRight", (buttons & (1L << Button.DPAD_RIGHT.value)) != 0);
1582    table.log("Misc1", (buttons & (1L << Button.MISC_1.value)) != 0);
1583    table.log("RightPaddle1", (buttons & (1L << Button.RIGHT_PADDLE_1.value)) != 0);
1584    table.log("LeftPaddle1", (buttons & (1L << Button.LEFT_PADDLE_1.value)) != 0);
1585    table.log("RightPaddle2", (buttons & (1L << Button.RIGHT_PADDLE_2.value)) != 0);
1586    table.log("LeftPaddle2", (buttons & (1L << Button.LEFT_PADDLE_2.value)) != 0);
1587    table.log("Touchpad", (buttons & (1L << Button.TOUCHPAD.value)) != 0);
1588    table.log("Misc2", (buttons & (1L << Button.MISC_2.value)) != 0);
1589    table.log("Misc3", (buttons & (1L << Button.MISC_3.value)) != 0);
1590    table.log("Misc4", (buttons & (1L << Button.MISC_4.value)) != 0);
1591    table.log("Misc5", (buttons & (1L << Button.MISC_5.value)) != 0);
1592    table.log("Misc6", (buttons & (1L << Button.MISC_6.value)) != 0);
1593  }
